claims.statement: For the explicit systematic product of 62 length-32 dimension-16 blocks and one length-16 dimension-8 tail, with the deterministic direct-address decoder specified in proof.md including its exceptional address behavior, the uniform-message average block error for 1000 bits over 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 499999967504042273/500000000000000000.
For the same product code and direct-address decoder, the fixed bsc-ops-v1 program in construction.py uses exactly W=283 operations on every received word, with W <= 2^(1629/200).

experiments.purpose: Enumerate both chosen-leader sets, compute exact successful mass excluded by the prefix and tail address stripe, and certify block error and operation count with exact arithmetic and reference-counter samples.
